fixtures.preview: Mauricio Pochettino's first match in charge comes at Anfield, with 18th-placed United facing a fourth-placed Liverpool side that has struggled at home.
talking_points: United are 18th on 8 points from 10 games with one league win, their lowest position at this stage since 1986-87, and have no clean sheet all season.
Pochettino has not beaten Liverpool in eight meetings as a manager (six defeats), though Liverpool haven't beaten United at Anfield since the 7-0 in March 2023.
Rashford's hip is being monitored daily and he is expected to play some part; Shaw is pushing to return, Martinez is back from suspension, and Sesko is out until the new year.
Liverpool have won only one of five at Anfield; Wirtz, Isak and Gakpo are in form, while Ekitike is out and Van Dijk is fit.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 of the league phase in Lisbon, three days after Anfield; United have no away win in any competition this season.
Brentford were 8th on 14 points in Sky's 8 Nov table and visit Old Trafford, likely Pochettino's home debut.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside against a side that was 12th on 12 points in Sky's 8 Nov table; Sky says fixtures are subject to change.
Coventry were one place above United in 17th on 9 points in Sky's 8 Nov table, so this could be a relegation-zone six-pointer.
Matchweek 5 in Redcliffe (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney), with Sydney coming off a 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Abel Walatee (ankle) and Jake Hollman (hamstring) are unavailable, per the club's squad article.
Ethan Dyer is away at the FIFA U-17 World Cup, and Akol Akon has dropped out of the squad for the same reason.
Nicko Alfaro, Marin France and Tyler Williams were promoted to the extended squad, with two players to be cut before kick-off.
Sydney play Brisbane again at Allianz Stadium on 2 Jan.

fixtures.preview: The first Big Blue of the season at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.
A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm New Zealand time (3pm Sydney), Matchweek 8.
A Friday-night home game against Perth Glory at 7:40pm.
A Monday-night home game against Macarthur FC at 7pm.

talking_points: Arsenal led the table on 27 points from 10 games in Sky's 8 Nov table, five clear of Brighton.

big_matches.title: Liverpool v Manchester United
big_matches.why: English football's biggest rivalry, with 18th-placed United under new coach Mauricio Pochettino for his first game.
talking_points: United have one league win from 10 and are in the relegation zone; Liverpool are 4th on 18 points.
Pochettino has not won any of his last eight meetings with Liverpool.
Rashford is expected to play some part and Shaw is pushing to return; Sesko is out until the new year.

talking_points: Arsenal were 3rd on 10 points after four games, behind only PSG and Real Madrid (12 each), in an earlier check.
A win would keep the top-eight automatic spots in sight.

big_matches.why: Real Madrid were 2nd on 12 points after matchday 4, level with leaders PSG, in an earlier check.
talking_points: Madrid can keep pace with PSG at the top of the league-phase table with a home win.
